candidates.description: TinyFish web search, page fetching, browser automation, and web research through its hosted MCP endpoint and CLI.
candidates.observed_version: @tiny-fish/cli 0.59.0; use-tinyfish skill installed from the official cookbook
dependencies: TinyFish account/API key for authenticated operations
Kilo CLI registration must be available to the TinyFish connector

install.windows: npm install -g @tiny-fish/cli; npx skills add github.com/tinyfish-io/tinyfish-cookbook --skill use-tinyfish
install.connect: tinyfish connect kilo (not run: connector reports kilo is not on PATH)

candidates.risk: external-web-access-and-browser-automation-can-interact-with-sites; enable only exact verified tools after authentication and functional validation

notes: TinyFish fue añadido mediante un commit posterior al baseline 13 y no había sido conectado ni autenticado.
Este catálogo opcional no se consume por el instalador del pack de 13 MCP.
No se infieren permisos de navegador o Web desde la presencia de una skill en source.
